ios.desc:
Bored or anxious? This dreamy app will make you feel good and alright. Manifest beauty with a touch of your lovely fingers. Flow with these swirling substances. Gorgeously calm visuals will conquer your soul and bring you to Heaven.

This beautiful creation will help everyone to stay calm and relieve this pesky anxiety from all minds. Like a magic lighter it will burn negative forces, created by sandbox mind. When you first launch it you're gonna be frozen by beauty, that beyond spectrum magnificence, that you have never ever seen before. Believe it or not, you'll become happy playing it, squeezing every second from it, to experience love and connection to our big dreamy Universe. Is it not yet convincing for you? Then you are the type of soul that this lovely app is made for. It's going to reassure your grumpiness, and you'll become enjoyably hot candle to be flowing with. Also show it to your kids, they're gonna like it. So what are you waiting for? Stop reading this and play it.

You may ask how this lovely creation works and I can say it works by forces of magic. Our Universe works by principles of emergence, small physical thoughts make all life possible. This fire app simulates smoke, lighter and good vibrations. This is a liquid water simulation of calm fluid life. The real antistress app that manifests your fire dreams. Watch out for your colorful swipes. Feel the flow. Become an enlightened soul. You should really stop reading this and install the app instead. Get a fresh dose of fluids to your mind! Just stop already! Do it!
